about: M13 trade goods (M13_TRADE.md). tools/trade_data.py turns this file into trade.bin: per city and good a base price (gold per load) and a producer level, plus city flags and market sizes. Prices: producer price * (1 + distance / per_hexes) ^ exp (capped at cap x), times the demand of the buyer's market group. Distance = hex distance to the nearest producer (cheaper producers count with their level factor).

price_model.note: 1 hex is about 8-9 km on this map (Rome-Chang'an 1005 hexes ~ 8100 km); China is Koei's map and is denser (Luoyang-Chang'an 26 hexes).

market.note: Loads a market absorbs before its price moves by trade_impact percent (worldmod.ini). Koei's 42 Chinese cities count as tier 1-like.

china_zhou.about: Koei's 42 cities (ids 0..41) are not in cities_world.json; their Han province (州) decides their producer region and market group.

groups.about: Market groups: the demand multiplier of a good applies to every city of the group. Regions not listed belong to no group (multiplier 1).

hubs.about: Entrepots: they buy and sell every good (others only sell what they produce), their prices recover faster (trade_revert_hub), transit tax is lower there (trade_tax_hub), their market is bigger. Silk road, incense road and the monsoon route.

cities.115: 敦煌 (Dunhuang, gate of the Western Regions)

goods.name: 絲
goods.sources: Han silk from 齊 (Qi, 臨淄 / 北海) and 兗豫 (襄邑 brocade at 陳留); Pliny NH 6.20, 12.84 (100 million sesterces a year to India, China and Arabia); silk in Rome sold for its weight in gold (late sources) - tens of times the Chinese price.

monsoon.about: M13 phase 3: monsoon seas (lo = west-east, hi = north-south, world hexes). months[0..11] = January..December: E = the south-west monsoon (eastbound sailing favoured: Red Sea / Arabia -> India -> Malaya -> China), W = the north-east monsoon (westbound favoured), T = change of the monsoon (storms, slow), - = no monsoon. Periplus of the Erythraean Sea 39, 49, 56-57 (leave Egypt in July, India in December-January); Pliny NH 6.104-106; Faxian (return 411-412). Step costs on sea hexes (worldmod.ini trade_monsoon_with / _against / _storm) and storm risk apply to caravans; AI route choice uses the same factors.

events.about: M13 phase 3: market news. Each month with probability worldmod.ini trade_event_chance % one event (weight) starts if fewer than trade_event_max are running. apply: consumers = the cities of the group that do not produce the good, producers = the producing cities of the group, all = every city of the group. good: a key, any (random good; for producers a good the group produces) or all. group: a market group or any (random; for producers a group with producers of the good). mult: price factor while it lasts; months: [min, max].

list.name: 流行
list.about: a fashion: Roman ladies and silk (Seneca, Pliny), Han court and glass / coral

list.name: 歉收
list.about: harvest failure / bad season at the producers: little to sell, prices up

list.name: 戰亂
list.about: war in a producing land: every good it makes is scarce

list.name: 疫病
list.about: plague (the Antonine plague 165-180, the plagues of 217 China): demand collapses

list.name: 豐收
list.about: a good year: producers sell cheap

merchants.about: M13 phase 4: officers known as merchants get the talent 商才 (1..2 extra merchant levels) the officer with "id" (= the roster id = the game's officer id, data/persons/roster.json), or for "koei": true Koei's own officer (ids 0..849) of exactly this name (姓+名 as the game stores it); names alone are ambiguous (three roster officers are 菲爾穆, the roster's 東萊太守 劉巴 is not Shu's). Only people attested as traders or trading families; officers with politics >= worldmod.ini trade_merchant_pol (80) get 商才 1 anyway.
